host_bandwidth_gb_s.basis: Grade-2 interface payload budget: 16 channels * x64 * 16 GT/s / 8 * 75% = 1536 GB/s per direction. Program latency separately limits media writes; no extra 16 GB/s write cap. OCP p16 vs pp32/35 payload-rate discrepancy remains unresolved.

host_read_bandwidth_gb_s.basis: Grade-2 interface payload budget: 16 channels * x64 * 16 GT/s / 8 * 75% = 1536 GB/s per direction. Program latency separately limits media writes; no extra 16 GB/s write cap. OCP p16 vs pp32/35 payload-rate discrepancy remains unresolved.

host_write_bandwidth_gb_s.basis: Grade-2 interface payload budget: 16 channels * x64 * 16 GT/s / 8 * 75% = 1536 GB/s per direction. Program latency separately limits media writes; no extra 16 GB/s write cap. OCP p16 vs pp32/35 payload-rate discrepancy remains unresolved.

queue_scope.basis: Local research translation: divide upstream 4096 read-page credits/stack over 16 host channels, then use 256 combined read/write credits and a 64-write subset per host channel. Not upstream queue semantics or OCP-mandated values.

max_outstanding_requests.basis: Local research translation: divide upstream 4096 read-page credits/stack over 16 host channels, then use 256 combined read/write credits and a 64-write subset per host channel. Not upstream queue semantics or OCP-mandated values.

max_outstanding_write_requests.basis: Local research translation: divide upstream 4096 read-page credits/stack over 16 host channels, then use 256 combined read/write credits and a 64-write subset per host channel. Not upstream queue semantics or OCP-mandated values.

internal_bandwidth_gb_s.basis: Per-core-channel payload rate = upstream raw 101.25 GB/s * 4096 / (4096 + 224 OOB) = 96 GB/s. No separate OOB, ECC or TSV stage is reproduced; zero fixed front delay is a local simplification.

front_ns.basis: Per-core-channel payload rate = upstream raw 101.25 GB/s * 4096 / (4096 + 224 OOB) = 96 GB/s. No separate OOB, ECC or TSV stage is reproduced; zero fixed front delay is a local simplification.
